visual_elements.description: Neural network diagram showing backpropagation weight updates. Left side has input dots connecting to three Sigma (Σ) nodes in first layer, each followed by f( ) boxes. Middle layer has three blue Sigma nodes labeled Netj and Oj. Right-middle layer has three green Sigma nodes labeled Netj and Oj. Outputs labeled Output 1, Output 2, Output m. Arrows show weights wji and wjj. Red text shows ∂E/∂wji and ∂E/∂Netj = -δj. Red highlighted node at top right output.

Bottom strip with blue border containing sigmoid activation equation

Circled number 1 in purple near bottom center of diagram
Green upward arrows with circled numbers near bottom of diagram
